speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you please describe the nature of your chest pain and when the vomiting started?

speaker: Patient
text: I can barely speak because my chest is burning with intense pain. It all started after I drank too much vodka and began vomiting forcefully. However, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of forceful vomiting followed by severe chest pain, I suspect a Boerhaave syndrome (esophageal rupture). REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Free mediastinal air visible, suggesting perforation

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of free mediastinal air confirms an esophageal rupture, which is a surgical emergency. DIAGNOSIS READY: Boerhaave syndrome
